title: silene angustifolia subsp. prostrata
intro: Silene angustifolia subsp. prostrata, commonly known as Creeping Silene, is a plant species that belongs to the Caryophyllaceae family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Creeping Silene include wound healing, antiviral, and antifungal activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of this plant also exhibit potential anti-cancer and neuroprotective effects, making it a subject of interest in modern pharmacology.
